description: Accessibility improvements for WhatsApp Desktop on Windows. Keeps NVDA on the message field while typing, reads what is under the mouse, and adds commands to move to the chat list, the message list and the message field.
changelog: The add-on can be enabled together with other WhatsApp add-ons: it no longer includes an app module, so it no longer replaces NVDA's own WhatsApp support or another WhatsApp add-on. Requires NVDA 2026.2 or later.
